findings.title: "视同 exhausted，复用既有切号路径" forces a fabricated scope+resetAt that corrupts observed fields, breaks pane revive, and mislabels the founder notification
findings.detail:
The R2 fix direction is right, but the chosen reuse target is wrong. The existing quota flow is typed `{kind:"quota", scope:"5h"|"weekly"|"both", resetAt: string}` (switch-executor.ts:79-85); a retirement has no honest value for EITHER field, so "复用既有 exhausted 执行流程" cannot be implemented without fabricating both. The plan's "不伪造" only covers the 100% usage observation and does not address resetAt.

Verified downstream damage, whichever value is chosen:
1. commitSwitch persists on the retiring account `quotaExhaustedUntil = trigger.resetAt`, `switchCooldownUntil = trigger.resetAt`, and for weekly/both `weeklyResetAt = trigger.resetAt` (switch-executor.ts:589-596) — a fabricated instant OVERWRITES the real observed weeklyResetAt, which then feeds earliestReset (account-store.ts:865-894), the capacity/patrol row (capacity-snapshot.ts:420) and candidateDecisionInputs (quota-monitor.ts:564-570).
2. reviveEpoch.expiresAt = Date.parse(accountTrigger.resetAt) + REVIVE_GRACE_MS (quota-monitor.ts:2184). Passing the real retiresAt (already in the past) yields an instantly-expired epoch; reviveScan then nulls it and sets `authorized = false` (quota-revive-scan.ts:313-321), so runner panes stuck on the retired account are never revived — the exact "runners stay stuck" outcome this fix exists to prevent.
3. formatSwitchNotification renders triggerLabel `quota:weekly` / `quota:5h` (account-switch-notification.ts:150-161) and openBlockedEpisode's no-target alert reports `scope=weekly` — the founder is told the account hit a quota cap when it actually retired.
4. The code carries an explicit invariant forbidding exactly this: "A triggering window is by definition open, so it must carry a reset instant. Null here is an API contract violation ... neither can ever see a fabricated timestamp" (quota-monitor.ts:1821-1826).
5. Structurally unreachable in the target scenario: `scope` comes from `triggerScope(currentUsage.ok, ...)` (quota-monitor.ts:1819) and the whole block sits after a SUCCESSFUL fetchUsage. The plan simultaneously requires the retirement switch to work when usage is unreadable, so the "existing exhausted flow" does not exist on that path — while "不得新增其他触发" forbids inventing one. The plan is internally inconsistent.

Failure scenario: business retires at 2026-09-14T00:00:00-07:00 while active. The retirement switch fires as a fabricated `quota:weekly` trigger; business's real weeklyResetAt is overwritten with the retirement instant, the founder gets a Discord notification saying business hit its weekly cap, and the revive epoch is born expired so every runner pane parked on business stays parked until someone notices.

Recommendation: reuse the existing `account_dead` trigger instead — `{kind:"account_dead", profile}` is left untouched by commitSwitch (switch-executor.ts:575-577), carries no scope/resetAt to fabricate, already has no-target/failure handling and founder copy, and `markAccountUnavailable` already exists for the terminal mark. That satisfies "不得新增其他触发" with zero fabrication.

findings.title: The specified insertion range still contains two early returns, including the one the retired-credential case actually hits
findings.detail:
The intent ("退休判定不能受 usage API unauthorized/blind 提前 return 阻断") is correct, but the stated placement — "在已取得可信 snapshot 后、常规 usage 读取失败分支前" — is a range that still contains two returns before the usage read: `if (state.backoffUntilMs > now && !witnessDue) return finish("backoff")` (quota-monitor.ts:1709-1713) and `if (snapshot.activeName === null || snapshot.activeCredential === null || snapshot.activeCredential.expiresAt <= now) { emitBlind(..., "credential_missing_or_expired"); return finish("blind") }` (quota-monitor.ts:1713-1721). Separately, `if (state.nextUsageDueAt > now && ... && !witnessDue) return result(...)` (quota-monitor.ts:1646-1657) returns before the snapshot is even read.

Failure scenario: after cancellation, business's pooled credential fails to refresh and `activeCredential.expiresAt <= now`. An implementer who satisfies the letter of the spec by inserting the check just above `fetchUsage` never reaches it — pollOnce returns blind at 1713 on every pass, and the R1 HIGH is unfixed for its single most likely manifestation. A long `retryAfterMs` backoff likewise skips both the trigger and the 60-minute warning.

Pin the insertion point to immediately after the machine-account authority check (quota-monitor.ts:1671-1682) and add explicit tests for (a) activeCredential === null / expired, (b) backoffUntilMs > now.

findings.title: Plan does not say whether the retirement trigger is subject to the silent anti-flap gate
findings.detail:
"复用现有切号/失败/无候选路径" inherits `if (state.lastSwitchAt !== null && now - state.lastSwitchAt < deps.config.config.minSwitchIntervalMinutes * 60_000) return finish("cooldown")` (quota-monitor.ts:1882-1888). That return emits no alert and writes no episode — it is completely silent. A quota threshold is a soft signal where anti-flap is correct; a retirement instant is a hard deadline where it is not, and the plan never states which applies.

Failure scenario: a 5h-quota switch lands at 23:50 PT, business retires at 00:00 PT. The retirement pass at ~00:05 is swallowed by the 15-minute default gate with no trace, and the next usage-due pass is up to basePollMinutes (20) later — roughly 35 minutes of the whole fleet running on a retired account, the same order of magnitude the R1 HIGH objected to. State explicitly whether minSwitchIntervalMinutes is bypassed for retirement and pin it with a test.

findings.title: The persisted warning dedup marker is a QuotaMonitorState schema change; parseState uses an exact key set and rollback discards the alert outbox
findings.detail:
"使用持久化的账号+到期时间去重标记，覆盖多 pass 以及状态重读" implies a new key in QuotaMonitorState, but item 6's compatibility claim covers only the account-store file. `parseState` validates with `hasOnlyKeys(value, V2_STATE_KEYS)` (quota-monitor-state.ts:1003 and 222-231) — an exact set, not a superset check. `setup-quota-monitor.sh`'s rollback-state mode applies the same exact-key rule for v1.

Failure scenario: the new daemon writes `retirementWarningCursor` into ~/.flywheel/quota-monitor-state.json; the build is then rolled back. The old parseState returns null, loadQuotaMonitorState falls to `conservativeState(...)` with `recovery: "corrupt"` (quota-monitor-state.ts:1138-1146), and emptyQuotaMonitorState resets `alertOutbox: []` (quota-monitor-state.ts:380) — undelivered founder alerts are dropped, along with blockedEpisode, pendingSwitchFailure, deadAccountEpisode, witnessCursor and confirmation.

First check whether the existing delivery-layer dedup suffices: lead-alert.sh dedupes on project|lead|kind|signature (documented at quota-monitor.ts:1844-1848), so `signature = quota-retirement-warning-<name>-<retiresAt>` gives once-ever semantics with no schema change (note every other signature deliberately embeds `day(now)` to re-fire daily, so this is a deviation worth stating). If monitor-side memory is genuinely required, say so and spell out the V2_STATE_KEYS addition plus the rollback story.

findings.title: Per-entry rejection (correct fix) now lets an invalid retiresAt reach the display surfaces item 4 calls "透传"
findings.detail:
Item 1's new wording — invalid retiresAt excludes only that account and never rejects the store — is the right fix for strict-read-whole-store-rejection. It does, however, mean an invalid string now survives in the store and flows to the surfaces item 4 describes as "capacity snapshot 透传可选退休日期", and the plan does not pin how it is handled there. Both plausible implementations are bad:

(a) literal pass-through — hook-payload validates every instant through `capacityInstant`, which throws on an unparseable value (hook-payload.ts:702-710); renderValidCapacityLines throwing collapses the ENTIRE capacity block to `容量=⚠️ 账面不可读(invalid_capacity_snapshot)` (hook-payload.ts:967-973), hiding disk, memory, load, runners and all quota rows behind one bad config character.

(b) normalization with the existing `validInstant` helper (capacity-snapshot.ts:163-167), which is plain Date.parse — a date-only `"2026-09-14"` renders as a plausible `business(9-13 到期)` on the patrol line while the selector has already excluded that account as invalid per the new strict offset rule, so two founder-facing surfaces state contradictory things and nothing signals the config is broken.

Specify that all three surfaces (panorama, capacity snapshot, patrol line) consume the same shared validator from item 1, and that an invalid value renders as an explicit invalid marker rather than a silently-parsed date or a blank.

findings.title: Lead-deferred, but the accepted R2 trigger raises this message's firing probability
findings.detail:
Not re-raised as blocking — the Lead has ruled this into Follow-ups. Recording only that the accepted fix changes its risk profile: before R2, the retired account simply sat in the seat; after R2, retirement now actively fires a switch attempt at a known instant, and "无候选保留既有 no-target 行为" routes straight to `no_account` with `earliestReset` (switch-executor.ts:1038), which account-switch-repair.ts:246-252 renders to the founder as "所有 Claude 账号都已用尽，最早 reset: <retired account 的 reset>。需要你处理(等 reset / 手动 login)". earliestReset (account-store.ts:865-894) filters neither auth nor retirement.

Failure scenario: business retires at 00:00 PT Sunday and everything else is exhausted; the founder is paged at exactly that instant and told to wait for a reset that can never restore the account. If the follow-up is not picked up soon, consider at least noting in the handoff that this message is known-misleading for retired accounts.
